images.caption:
Wrapping up #mypubliclandsroadtrip Week 8 – Places to Beat the Heat – at Lake Vermilion.
In the 1940’s, the National Geographic Society declared Lake Vermilion one of the top ten most scenic lakes in the United States. And it still is today.
The BLM manages about 87 islands in northeast Minnesota, many of them on Lake Vermilion. A little known getaway, even among locals, the islands offer over 1200 miles of shoreline and some 40 miles along wilderness. The islands primarily are small at half an acre or less, but are great stops for fishing, picnicking, or a day away. 
And several islands are set up for overnight camping! Nothing beats an overnight #mypubliclandsroadtrip with waves crashing against the rocks and loons gently calling in the distance.

Photos by BLM Eastern States
